what: CRITICAL publish workflow: aide-v0 is the dev monorepo containing both legacy project and aide-memory. Publishing means ONLY aide-memory-related files ship, minified and bundled. The publish manifest is package.aide-memory.json (not package.json which is the dev monorepo manifest). Must follow docs/RELEASING.md explicitly step by step. The verify script (scripts/verify-package.sh) gates this. Never rush the publish flow. Understand the project structure fully before touching anything.
